title: Worker lease + operationId + unknown outcome (VI.3 + A-1/A-2/A-8)
database: PostgreSQL 17 (Testcontainers postgres:17-alpine), one database per engine

scenarios.name: Crash after successful PI before completion; lease expires; re-fetch with a new lockVersion; retry with the same operationId; class (a) pays once
Same crash with class (b): outcome lookup (PD) before any repeat; no second PI
Undeclared topic (A-8 default class c) on an IFMS without idempotency/lookup: no automatic repeat, UNKNOWN_OUTCOME reconciliation item, resolved by an officer
Control: the same class-(c) IFMS with the topic wrongly declared (a) pays twice (shows the duplicate check works and why A-8 defaults to c)
Stale worker completes after another worker re-acquired: rejected (409 STALE_LEASE), nothing changes; the current holder completes

rejections: ledger:409 STALE_LEASE: operation d37d08ee-931b-5712-9e59-5d1b5070debd is INTENT at lockVersion 2

scenarios.name: Network cut: the lease expires (2x lease) while worker-1's PI is still running; no redispatch before expiry; exactly one completion; the second attempt reuses the operationId

measurements.worker1LateCompletion: ledger:409 STALE_LEASE: operation 4e363596-84f0-5c12-a9f1-d71dba0438ee is SUCCEEDED at lockVersion 3

scenarios.name: Effects ledger: no operationId paid twice across counted scenarios
Probe: a lease ended inside the adapter (executeDueJobs, e.g. a timer run, before the product sweep) bypasses the A-8 decision; does class-(c) work get re-dispatched?

measurements.explanation: LeaseTable.expire runs inside fetchAndLock/executeDueJobs of both adapters without a product callback; OperationLedger.recordIntent then treats the higher lockVersion as a normal new attempt for any capability class, so the A-8 'no automatic repeat' rule depends on the product sweep running first

notes.clock: engine clock fixed and advanced by the test (Env.setClock); no real-time sleeps
notes.leaseExpirySweep: product-side sweep (PaymentWorker.sweepExpiredLeases) at the engine clock: OperationLedger.onLeaseExpired(op, lockVersion+1) then LeaseTable.expire, one engine transaction, before every fetch
notes.unknownOutcomeHold: work whose operation is UNKNOWN_OUTCOME is released (unlockExternal) and never dispatched until an officer resolves it; neither adapter offers a 'held' state for external work
